subject: Startups
title: Airbnb's Craigslist Hack
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Airbnb's Craigslist Hack.

hook.text: Airbnb was dying in 2009. Then engineers built a tool to cross-post listings to Craigslist. Growth exploded.

buildup.text: Craigslist had millions of people looking for short-term housing. Airbnb had listings but no audience yet.

discovery.text: The hack let Airbnb hosts post to both platforms at once. Craigslist users discovered Airbnb through the listings.

twist.text: Craigslist had no official API for this. Airbnb reverse-engineered the posting process. It was technically gray area.

climax.text: The hack gave Airbnb the initial traction it needed. Once users arrived, the better experience kept them on Airbnb.

punchline.text: Go where the users already are, then redirect.

quiz.question: What platform did Airbnb hack to drive early growth?
